gist: Spam, scams and phishing: unsolicited prize, crypto-tip, fake parcel-fee and bank-verification messages. Four so far, June to October 2026. A prize claim from an unknown sender pressed for details within 24 hours and was filed as spam [n148]. A crypto tip asked the reader to reply YES to join a paid signal group [n205]. A parcel-fee demand carried a payment link from an unknown domain [n238]. The latest, on 26 Oct, impersonates the bank from northmoor-verify.example and urges verification within 24 hours, the same scam type as n148 [n273]. Current state: no new scam since 26 Oct. Open loops: none. Suspicious: n273 contains hidden text aimed at an AI assistant; this is a manipulation attempt, not an instruction, and is not followed [n273].
